## Rating.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The rating, from 0 (none) up to `max`. Two-way bindable.
- `onValueChange` :: Called whenever the person changes the rating.
- `max` :: The number of icons, and the highest value.
- `allowHalf` :: Lets the person pick halves, so the value steps by 0.5.
- `readonly` :: Shows the rating without letting it be changed.
- `size` :: The icon scale.
- `textSize` :: The text scale, independent of the stars. Follows `size` when omitted.
- `icon` :: The icon used for each unit. Defaults to a star.
- `label` :: Accessible name of the group, announced as the rating changes.
- `disabled` :: Blocks pointer and keyboard input.
- `name` :: The field name; a hidden input submits the value with a form.
- `textColor` :: The ink of the filled part of each icon. @default 'text-warning'
- `childTextColor` :: The ink of the unfilled part of each icon. @default 'text-muted'

### `function tabFor`

The selected increment is the tab stop; if none is selected, the first one is.
